data.name: Aabid
data.gender_notes: Aabid is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿābid (عابد) 'worshipper, one who serves (God)', the active participle of ʿabada 'to worship, to serve', from the root ʿ-b-d. The same root forms ʿibāda 'worship' and the theophoric element ʿabd 'servant'. Aabid therefore means “Worshipper; devout servant (of God)”. Arabic active participle ʿābid 'worshipper'; a standard Muslim male given name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabid expresses “Servant of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabid total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

faq.q: What is the root of the name Aabid?
faq.a: Aabid comes from the Arabic root ʿ-b-d (ع-ب-د), which carries the sense of worship and service. The same root gives ʿibāda 'worship' and ʿabd 'servant', so Aabid means 'one who worships'.

faq.q: What does the name Aabid mean?
Where does the name Aabid come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabid?
faq.a: The root of Aabid is ع-ب-د (ʿ-b-d).

faq.q: How is Aabid written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabid is written عابد in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabid a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabid is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aabid appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabid is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabid verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Worshipper; devout servant (of God)” is established by Arabic active participle ʿābid 'worshipper'; a standard Muslim male given name..
